summary: Retain DRFortress as a standalone company rather than merging it into 1547. Harrison Street and 1547 jointly acquired the company from GI Partners in April 2025; GI's former majority position belongs to its Data Infrastructure Fund, and the public evidence does not support the repository's Harrison Street Digital Fund label. The founders remain operators, but their post-2025 equity is unresolved, so the complete ownership correction is held for targeted review.
blockingQuestions: Did founders or management retain any equity after the April 2025 sale, and if so through which entity and at what percentage?
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: The Harrison/1547 percentages, buyer SPVs and exact legal close day were not publicly disclosed.
The Harrison Street fund or managed-account attribution was not publicly disclosed.
Completion of the later planned 500 kW expansion phase was not independently verified.
